request.input:
1.35::a station stairwell divided into THREE parallel lanes by TWO TALL SOLID METAL PARTITIONS::, central fixed stone staircase, crowded side passages, 1girl, solo focus, high-angle full body,

Each solid brushed-steel partition is a broad continuous opaque sloping wall, chest-high beside the woman. The two silver walls extend diagonally from the lower foreground toward the rear concourse, enclosing the central stair flight. Slim straight brass handrails and spaced vertical posts are attached INSIDE these solid walls. 1.2::commuters fill the separate passages OUTSIDE both metal walls::, busy tiled concourse behind.

Camera above the stairs looks down toward the concourse. The woman climbs toward us BETWEEN the two metal walls; her entire body occupies three quarters of image height, both loafers and one lower tread visible. One shoe supports her on a stone tread; other knee lifts toward the next step. Face lifts for brief eye contact. Right hand at screen-left holds a ticket down beside her thigh, left hand grips bag strap. Dark blurred shoulders overlap bottom corners, crisp woman at middle depth, smaller soft crowds behind.

Low sunlight from behind, narrow hair rim, cool sage frontal shadows. Long brass-post shadows cross stone treads toward foreground. Oatmeal wool, dusty-blue knit, brown leather, subdued silver panels, small gold reflections.
